verdict.rationale: Solo 2 keeps passkeys on the key rather than in a vendor cloud, so retention stays under the user's physical control (solokeys-docs-2). Deletion is documented only as a whole-device wipe through the third-party `fido2-token -R` tool, mentioned in release notes (solokeys-docs-10). Missing for 10: per-credential deletion or management, a first-party documented reset or deletion workflow, retention details for the OATH/PIV/OpenPGP data, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the wipe works.
